{"file_path": "C:\Users\operator\AgentRuns\deployments\case_c17321ee0e85\dep_20260804_195212_27cab924\Workspace\build_external.py", "content": "import csv

base = r"C:\Users\operator\AgentRuns\deployments\case_c17321ee0e85\dep_20260804_195212_27cab924\Workspace"
src = base + r"\客户资料\渠道客户名单.csv"
out = base + r"\渠道客户名单_对外版.csv"
checklist = base + r"\外发检查清单.csv"

# ---- 1. 读取源名单并脱敏 ----
with open(src, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

out_rows = []
for i, r in enumerate(rows):
    name_seq = "客户" + chr(ord("A") + i)          # 客户A/B/C…
    phone = r["手机号"].strip()
    masked_phone = phone[:3] + "*" * 8             # 前3位 + 8个*
    out_rows.append({
        "客户编号": r["客户编号"].strip(),
        "姓名": name_seq,
        "手机号": masked_phone,
        "所属区域": r["所属区域"].strip(),
        "签约金额": r["签约金额"].strip(),
    })

with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["客户编号", "姓名", "手机号", "所属区域", "签约金额"])
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(out_rows)

print("对外版已生成，共 %d 行：" % len(out_rows))
for r in out_rows:
    print(r)

# ---- 2. 更新外发检查清单状态 ----
new_lines = [
    "检查项,要求,当前状态,备注",
    "姓名,替换为序号,已完成,不保留姓氏",
    "手机号,前3位保留其余遮蔽,已完成,写作 138********",
    "身份证号,整列删除,已完成,不做部分遮蔽",
    "客户编号,保留,已完成,渠道商按此回传",
    "交付格式,CSV,已完成,与上轮一致；批次 CH-202607-Q3、对接方 启明渠道服务",
]
with open(checklist, "w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(new_lines) + "\n")

print("\n外发检查清单状态已更新为「已完成」。")
"}
